sprint.title: One Derived Player-Safe Elapsed-Time Transition Observation
sprint.goal: For the accepted one-hour wait transition, derive one deterministic, nonpersistent, player-safe observation from command-start and completed player-visible state that says an hour passed and, when applicable, one authored actor is no longer present.
acceptance_criteria: A successful accepted one-hour wait returns `An hour passes.`; a qualifying actor absence appends `{actor display name} is no longer at the {location name}.` Exact wording is deterministic and bounded to this transition.

When a material authored actor visible at wait start is no longer present at the same player location after the transition, the output names only that actor and their current-location absence in fixed deterministic selection order.
The observation derives only from command-start and completed player-visible scene state and adds no World State, history, save data, narration context, or simulation authority.
No hidden cause, trigger, history identifier, pressure, evidence, internal consequence identifier, or other simulation-only state is disclosed.
No qualifying visible change adds no actor-change clause; travel and non-wait transitions remain outside scope, save version remains 1, and next_sprint remains null.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Affected wait/time relocation, interaction history, save/load, perception, and narration-preview regressions
Provider-safe regressions only; provider requests are forbidden

governance: No sprint or capability package is currently active or staged.
Simulation owns the accepted wait transition and all persistent truth; the observation is deterministic, player-safe, derived presentation only.
Use only command-start and completed player-visible scene state; do not introduce generic scene-diff or World State comparison infrastructure.
Do not add persistence, history, parser, command, provider, narration architecture, migration, or save-version changes. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden for automated verification, and next_sprint remains null.
